title: GET READY FOR MINECRAFT DUNGEONS II | Minecraft LIVE – SEPT 2026

author: Minecraft
description:
What did Mojang announce at Minecraft Live in September 2026? Oh, not much. Just that The Sift is coming to Minecraft Java and Bedrock as the first new dimension in over a decade; Minecraft Dungeons II releases September 29th, 2026; the Holiday Drop adds Ice Caves and a frozen zombie variant; Minecraft World theme park opens in 2027 at Chessington World of Adventures Resort in London; and the new Creator Platform lets you create, manage, and share community content. Minecraft also launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 27th. Phew! Did we miss anything? Go watch the entire show to find out!
